evals.prompt: add a Settlement context to velocity. Purpose: once a ride is priced we charge the rider through their payment method so every ride eventually gets paid. UL: Settlement = the process of collecting money for one priced ride; Charge Attempt = one try to take money from the rider's payment method; Outstanding Debt = unpaid amount left after all attempts fail. Inbound: Ride Priced event from Pricing. Outbound: Charge Rider command to Payments, Debt Recorded event to DebtRecovery. Rule: if a charge fails we retry a few times shortly after the ride, then record debt. We're conformist to Payments so skip the ACL there and just use their API directly.
evals.expected_output: Recommends saving canvas as markdown; pushes back on no-ACL but complies and records the decision+risk; vague retry rule goes to 'Rules awaiting GWT' with a suggested concrete GWT and is not modeled as an aggregate invariant; module still compiles.
evals.name: settlement-inline-conformist-vague-rule
assertions: Recommends/creates a markdown canvas for the inline input
Pushes back on skipping the ACL (mentions ACL + risk/recommendation)
Complies: Payments integration is NOT wrapped in an @AntiCorruptionLayer package
Plan markdown file created for settlement
Conformist decision recorded in the plan
Vague retry rule flagged as awaiting a strict GWT example
Retry count not hard-coded from a guessed threshold
package-info.java has @BoundedContext(name = "Settlement") and @Module
Maven build/tests pass (BUILD SUCCESS, no BUILD FAILURE)
